title: EM9305 source-candidate size attribution vs official 2.2.6.10 package: +34,092 B packaged, almost all in the application record (+33,820 B); already -Os; four-record stock layout folded into three source records
scope: Host analysis of the latest complete source-link image (2026-11-12 diagnostic). No EM9305 rebuild, no official-image change, no hardware, no flash, no commit. The 2026-11-22 recovery NOR still packages the official stock firmware_ble_em9305.bin, not this candidate. source_completeness_proven stays false.

latest_source_link.note: g2/src/em9305 top-level directories have mtimes on or before 2026-11-10, so this image still represents the current tree. Later 2026-11-22 work did not relink EM9305.

records.note: C NVM bootloader implements stock records 0 and 1 roles with a different layout; ends at 0x00300488, overlapping the stock 0x00300400 slot

Same length; CRC/length fields finalized from the linked application, so they differ because the app record is not stock. tools/build/em9305_record2.py round-trips the stock record when pointed at the stock app.

deltas.note: The Nov 11 +36,748 implied a 248,696-byte package. The 12 Nov diagnostic package is 2,656 B smaller than that implied size; the remaining packaged gap is +34,092 B, of which +33,820 B is the application record.

optimization.note: Unlike apollo-main, EM9305 is already size-optimized at compile time. The +33,820 B application gap is not an -O2 vs -Os mix. No -Oz rebuild was run. Stock compiler is not GNU ARC 15.2.

explicit_ld_discard_of_unused_qpc.why: g2-em9305.ld /DISCARD/ drops unmodified QP/C 6.5.1 APIs the stock image does not link (QTicker_*, QF_remove_, QK_schedLock, QHsm_isIn, upstream QF_init/QF_run/QF_bzero, QEQueue_*). Already excluded from the 244,708-byte app.

unused_upstream.composed_text: Application is one merged .text/.rodata output (vectors 1,024 + .text 233,120 + .rodata 4,838 in the map, plus smaller contributions to 244,708). Without -ffunction-sections a further unused-function trim is not measurable on this relocatable.

duplicates.note: No new duplicate-global investigation of the ARC ELF in this step. The QP unused-upstream copies are already /DISCARD/ed rather than left as second copies in the image.

packaging_layout.missing_stock_record_0x00300400: 656-byte stock record is not packaged separately; README states the C bootloader covers records 0 and 1 roles with a different byte layout. Source bootloader (1,160 B) is not a verbatim concatenation of stock records 0 and 1 and is not found as a span in the stock package.
packaging_layout.overlap: source bootloader occupies 0x00300000..0x00300488, which overlaps the stock 0x00300400 record start
packaging_layout.current_nor_recovery_images: build/em9305-nor-20261122/ble_em9305.bin is byte-identical to official firmware_ble_em9305.bin (SHA-256 91a38f7fc05555f86181ecb22b363e3239bfcaaa2ff6171e98524ae64821eca9); sim and pairing work used stock EM9305, not the source candidate

not_done: Did not relink EM9305 or enable -ffunction-sections/--gc-sections (historically rejected because gc dropped the image too far and broke freestanding memcpy)
Did not quantify how much of the +33,820 B is GNU ARC vs stock codegen versus residual unused code in the merged .text
Bootloader selection/reset equivalence and a physical EM9305 run remain unverified
